Why agency communication fails, what changed, and what we built around it

In this issue

  • The Ratio Flipped. Agentic development tools changed the math. Not the development.
  • Make the Client the Hero. This is the part I care about most.
  • LoopStack. We are calling the model LoopStack. Build. Fill.
  • The AI Advantage Is Not the AI. Every company in ecommerce services is talking about AI right now.
  • Why Now. Plan-first development is not new. Communicating with clients is not new.
